en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small Central European town square, showing tiled-roof houses, a central open square with people and a column or monument, and two prominent church towers—one with a slender spire and one with an onion-shaped dome. The scene is surrounded by low-rise historic buildings, with distant fields and hills in the background. Printed text at the bottom in red and smaller black type identifies the town and publisher.
